Type corrections. I re-listed the pieces below under the same ids with the right type, because I had misread them from the small icons. Everything else stays as given.

b45 and b50 (page 22 and 24 fender sub-assemblies) are Bracket 1 x 1 - 1 x 1 Inverted (lego-36840), not Technic bricks. That is why the 1 x 1 plate sits beside them. The Technic bricks (lego-6541, 2 in the list) are b40 and b41 from page 13.

b65 and b68 (pages 28 and 29) are the White Brick Curved 2 x 2 x 2/3 (lego-15068), not 2 x 1 curved bricks. b96 (page 34) is the White Plate Special 2 x 2 with Only 2 studs (lego-33909), not a corner plate.
b109, b110, b112, b113 (page 38) and b117, b118 (page 40) are Black Plate Round 1 x 1 with Solid Stud (lego-6141), not clip tiles or round tiles. This gives 7 black round plates in total.

b155 and b156 (page 50) are Dark Turquoise Plate Special 1 x 2 with Pin Hole on Top (lego-11458), not handle plates. That is why the gray pins go into their pin holes. The handle plates (lego-60478) are only b170 and b171.
I re-listed the pin and tail-light join edges on the bracket pieces (b45, b50) with empty ports. A lego-36840 bracket has no pin hole, so the earlier pin-hole ports were wrong.

Still unresolved: the 4 pins b18-b21 on the wheel holders (page 14) are extras beyond the 6 lego-4274 in the parts list, and they are not real separate parts. The correct 6 are b42, b43, b55, b60, b160 and b161. I cannot remove pieces in this additions-only pass. Those 4 should be dropped, and the wheel joins on page 58 attach to the holder's integral pegs.
The parts list has no minifigure parts, so the minifigures are not in the graph.

The mismatch report is unchanged. My last reply re-listed pieces under existing ids with corrected types, and it had no effect. This pass only accepts new pieces and edges, so it cannot change the type of a piece I already placed. I am not adding the 'missing' pieces as new ids. They are the same physical pieces already in the graph under a wrong type, so adding them would count each one twice.

Cause of the mismatch: I misread small icons on pages 22, 24, 28, 29, 34, 38, 40 and 50. Each wrongly typed id should be retyped as follows: b45 and b50 become lego-36840 (they are not lego-6541). b65 and b68 become lego-15068 White (they are not lego-11477). b96 becomes lego-33909 White (it is not lego-2420). b109, b110, b112, b113, b117 and b118 become lego-6141 Black (they are not lego-15712 or lego-6141 mixed up). b155 and b156 become lego-11458 Dark Turquoise (they are not lego-60478).

After those retypes, the counts match the parts list, except for 4 extra lego-4274. Those are b18-b21 on the wheel holders (page 14), which are not separate pieces. The wheel holder has its own pegs, and the 6 real pins are b42, b43, b55, b60, b160 and b161. Those four ids should be dropped, with the wheel joins on page 58 attached to the holders b16 and b17 instead.
The sticker sheet (b39) is one physical sheet, so the repeated stick edges to b36 and b149 are intentional. The minifigures are not in the parts list, so they are not in the graph.
